  - "README.md"

# JQB Docs Maintenance Rules

- Keep implementation and docs synchronized in the same task.
- If behavior changes, document migration or compatibility notes.
- Update docs index pages when adding or renaming pages.
- Keep examples lists current when adding/changing examples.
- Ensure assistant guidance files remain aligned with actual architecture.
